<title level="1" right="Hazard 6" pfs="">[Unholy Hunger](/Hazards.aspx?ID=431)</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #197: Let the Leaves Fall](/Sources.aspx?ID=222) pg. 50

**Complexity** Simple

</column>

A miasma of foul-smelling vapor with shrieking faces barely visible in the steam bubbles up from the soup.

---

**Stealth**
DC 25 (expert)

**Disable**
DC 19 [Cooking  Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=41) to neutralize the haunted stew with the addition of a few select spices from nearby shelves, or DC 25 [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=46) to exorcise the haunt

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

**Worse Than it Smells** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([conjuration](/Traits.aspx?ID=33), [occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=662)) **Trigger** A non-nindoru creature takes the lid off the cooking pot; **Effect** All creatures within 15 feet of the pot must succeed at a DC 27 Fortitude save or become [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=91) 2. The triggering creature instead must attempt a DC 24 Will save to resist the compulsion to dip their face into the stew and swallow a mouthful of the stuff (this effect has the [enchantment](/Traits.aspx?ID=61) and [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647) traits). On a failure, the triggering creature takes 5d6 poison damage (DC 24 basic Fortitude save).

---
**Reset**
 The haunt resets 1 round after the lid is replaced on the cooking pot.
